welcome.title: WELCOME TO STAR HEALTH
welcome.description: At Star Health, we do more than treat illness — we care for you as a person. You are not a case number — you are family. From diagnosis to healing, we stand with you.

safety.title: We Prioritize Your Health, Safety and Well-being
safety.description: Star Health Medical Centre is designed for your peace of mind - from hygiene protocols to a calming patient experience. From entry to exit, your health and peace of mind matters the most.
safety.point1: Our team is trained to care with empathy, not just efficiency.
safety.point2: We ensure smooth patient flow to minimize waiting and stress.
safety.point3: Our clean, quiet spaces are designed to help you relax and feel at home.

services.title: Our Services
services.description: Whatever your health concern — big or small — we’ll treat you with warmth, honesty, and care just like family.

generalMedicine.title: General Medicine
generalMedicine.description: Feeling unwell or just need a routine check-up? Our doctors are here to listen, guide, and help you stay healthy — one visit at a time.

familyMedicine.title: Family Medicine
familyMedicine.description: Your trusted family doctor — from kids to grandparents. Our family doctors take the time to listen, and care — just like someone who’s known you for years.

internalMedicine.title: Internal Medicine
internalMedicine.description: Managing diabetes, hypertension, or other long-term conditions? We’ll work with you closely, explain every step, and ensure you’re never alone in your care journey.

obg.title: Obstetrics & Gynecology (OBG)
obg.description: From pregnancy care to women’s wellness, our OBG specialists offer trusted, private, and supportive care — every step of the way.

generalDentistry.title: Dentistry & Orthodontics
generalDentistry.description: Healthy smiles start here. From cleanings to braces and smile correction, our dental team combines expertise and precision in every visit.

ortho.title: Orthopedics
ortho.description: From joint pain to injuries, our Orthopedics team is only a call away — ready to support you through recovery always with care.

laboratory.title: Laboratory
laboratory.description: When it comes to your health, trust matters. Our laboratory delivers accurate results with care, honesty, and attention.

pediatrics.title: Pediatrics
pediatrics.description: Family-centered care supporting the growth and wellness of children.

medicalTeam.title: Meet Our Medical Team
medicalTeam.description: Behind every smile and every recovery is a caring team of doctors who truly listen, guide, and treat you like family. From first visit to full recovery, you’re in trusted hands.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.helpText: Can't find what you're looking for?

q1.question: How can I book an appointment and check doctor availability?
q1.answer: You can book a specialist appointment through our website's online portal. Alternatively, call our appointment helpline at +966 505 730 003. Our coordinators will assist you with available slots. You may also visit the specific department's outpatient clinic directly. Please have your medical details ready when booking.

q2.question: What makes Star Health more than just a Medical Center?
q2.answer: You're supported by more than just skilled doctors in Star Health. Every member of our team is here to help by offering care, guidance, and service you can rely on. We combine expert staff with advanced medical technology to give patients the attention and treatment they truly deserve.

q3.question: What insurance plans do you accept?
q3.answer: We accept most major insurance plans. If your provider isn't listed on our Insurance page, feel free to call and confirm. We also offer affordable care options to ensure everyone gets the treatment they need.

q4.question: How do you ensure patient privacy and data security?
q4.answer: We follow strict privacy protocols and comply with healthcare regulations to ensure all personal and medical information remains confidential and secure.

q5.question: Do you provide follow-up care?
q5.answer: Yes, we offer follow-up consultations to monitor recovery and ensure optimal outcomes. Our team will guide you through the necessary post-treatment or post-surgery care.

intro.paragraph1: Star Health Medical Centre (Star Health', 'we', 'our', or 'us') is committed to protecting your privacy and safeguarding your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your information when you visit our website
intro.consent: By using our website, you consent to the practices described in this Privacy Policy.

informationWeCollect.title: 1. Information We Collect
informationWeCollect.description: We collect information to provide safe, efficient, and personalized healthcare services.

personalInfo.title: a. Personal Information
personalInfo.description: We may collect personal details that you voluntarily provide, including but not limited to:
items: Medical or health-related information you choose to share
Any information submitted through forms on the website
personalInfo.collectedWhen: This information is typically collected when you:
collectionMethods: Submit a contact or enquiry form
Communicate with us via email or phone

automaticInfo.title: b. Automatically Collected Information
automaticInfo.description: When you visit our website, certain information may be collected automatically, such as:
items: Pages visited and time spent on the website
automaticInfo.purpose: This data helps us understand how visitors use our website and improve user experience.

howWeUseInfo.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
howWeUseInfo.description: We use your information responsibly and only for legitimate purposes, including:
purposes: Improving our website and service quality
Ensuring patient safety and operational efficiency
Sending important updates or service-related information
Complying with legal and regulatory requirements
howWeUseInfo.note: We do not use your personal data for unrelated purposes without your consent.

cookies.title: 3. Cookies and Website Technologies
cookies.intro: Our website uses cookies and similar technologies to enhance your browsing experience.
cookies.note: You can manage or disable cookies through your browser settings. Please note that disabling cookies may affect certain features of the website.

sharingInfo.title: 4. Sharing and Disclosure of Information
sharingInfo.intro: We respect your privacy and do not sell or rent your personal information.
sharingInfo.sharedWith: Your data may be shared only when necessary, including with:
recipients: Authorized healthcare professionals involved in your care
Trusted service providers supporting our website and systems
Regulatory or legal authorities, if required by law
Third parties, only with your explicit consent
sharingInfo.note: All third parties are required to handle your information securely and confidentially.

dataSecurity.title: 5. Data Security
dataSecurity.description: We take data protection seriously and implement appropriate security measures to safeguard your information, including:
measures: Secure servers and encrypted data storage
Restricted access to authorized personnel only
dataSecurity.disclaimer: While we take all reasonable steps to protect your data, no online system is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

thirdPartyLinks.title: 6. Third-Party Links
thirdPartyLinks.content: Our website may contain links to third-party websites for additional information or services. Star Health Medical Centre is not responsible for the privacy practices or content of external websites. We encourage users to review the privacy policies of any third-party sites they visit.

childrenPrivacy.title: 7. Children's Privacy
childrenPrivacy.content: Our services and website are not intended for children under the age of 16. We do not knowingly collect personal information from minors. If such information is identified, it will be promptly removed from our records.

privacyRights.title: 8. Your Privacy Rights
privacyRights.description: We take data protection seriously and implement appropriate security measures to safeguard your information, including:
rights: Secure servers and encrypted data storage
Restricted access to authorized personnel only
privacyRights.note: While we take all reasonable steps to protect your data, no online system is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

policyUpdates.title: 9. Policy Updates
policyUpdates.content: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically to reflect changes in our practices or legal requirements. Any updates will be posted on this page with a revised 'Last Updated' date. We encourage you to review this policy regularly.
